cases.situation: Landlord Ray emailed that my rent goes from $1,650 to $1,950 at renewal in December. Similar 1-beds on my block are $1,700 to $1,800. I've been here 4 years and never paid late.
cases.reply:
Hi Ray,
Thanks for the heads-up about the increase to $1,950. I'd like to ask you to reconsider. Comparable one-bedrooms on this block are listed at $1,700 to $1,800, and I've paid on time for four years. I'd be glad to sign another 12 months at $1,750. Would that work? Happy to talk by phone.
Best,
Nina
cases.note: Counter with a number and facts, not a flat no. If he holds firm, meet halfway and attach a repair to it.

cases.situation: Bin Ende August ausgezogen. Mein Vermieter Herr Vogt will 350 € fürs Streichen von der Kaution (1.200 €) abziehen, obwohl die Wände laut Übergabeprotokoll in Ordnung waren. Die 60 € für die Reinigung sind okay.
cases.reply:
Sehr geehrter Herr Vogt,
vielen Dank für die Abrechnung. Den Abzug von 350 € für das Streichen kann ich nicht akzeptieren: Im Übergabeprotokoll vom 31. August sind die Wände als einwandfrei vermerkt, die Fotos hänge ich an. Die 60 € für die Reinigung akzeptiere ich. Bitte überweisen Sie mir die verbleibenden 1.140 € bis zum 16. Oktober. Ich würde das gern direkt mit Ihnen klären, rufen Sie mich gern an.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Lena Hoffmann
cases.note: Den berechtigten Posten anzuerkennen macht den Widerspruch beim Rest glaubwürdiger.

cases.situation: 装修师傅报价说好全屋刷墙8000，现在结账要10500，说是多加了一遍腻子。之前完全没跟我提过要加钱。
cases.reply: 李师傅，这段时间辛苦了。当时说好的全屋刷墙是8000，这次的单子是10500，多出来的2500能跟我说说具体是哪几项吗？加腻子的事之前没跟我确认过。说好的8000我今天就先转给您，剩下的咱们对一下再说。
cases.note: 先付没有争议的部分，只对差额提问，不指责对方故意多收。

cases.situation: Our heating has been broken since Sept 14. I texted our landlord Donna that day and again on the 21st, she said 'I'll get someone out' and nothing happened. Nights are getting cold and we have two little kids.
cases.reply:
Hi Donna,
This is a formal repair request for the heating, first reported to you by text on 14 September and again on the 21st. It still isn't working, and with two young children at home and nights now close to freezing, it can't wait much longer. Under the lease, heating repairs are the landlord's responsibility. Please confirm a repair date by Monday 5 October. I'd still prefer to sort this informally, so do call me on 07700 900 482.
Thanks,
Owen
cases.note: Third step on the ladder: dates of the earlier requests, the lease cited once, and one dated ask. Not a threat yet.

cases.situation: I'm a landlord. My tenant Omar has been great for 3 years. He paid only $700 of his $1,400 September rent and texted that he lost shifts at the warehouse. October rent is due Thursday.
cases.reply: Hi Omar, thanks for telling me straight away, and I'm sorry about the shifts. The $700 balance for September is still outstanding, and October's $1,400 is due Thursday 1 October. Could we agree a plan in writing by Friday? One option: the $700 split into two payments of $350, added to your October and November rent. If something else works better for you, tell me and we'll work it out.
cases.note: Landlord side: exact amounts and dates, one concrete plan offered, and room for his version.

cases.situation: 房东突然说要卖房，让我10月底前搬走。合同签到明年2月底，里面写了房东提前解约要提前一个月通知并赔一个月租金（4,500元）。我可以搬，但时间太紧，想争取一下。
cases.reply: 王姐您好，卖房的事收到了，我理解，也愿意配合。10月底前找房加搬家时间比较紧，我想11月15号前搬完。按合同第八条，房东提前解约需赔付一个月租金4,500元，麻烦您在我交钥匙当天把押金和这4,500元一起退给我。这段时间带人看房我都配合，提前一天说一声就行。您看这样可以吗？周五前回我一下，我好开始安排。
cases.note: 合同只引用一次、语气平和，把要求落到具体日期和金额；配合看房是让对方好答应的筹码。

cases.situation: Hired a kitchen fitter, Wes, for £9,200. I've paid £6,000 so far and the last £3,200 is due on completion. He was meant to finish on 18 September. The worktops and sink still aren't in and his texts have been vague for a week.
cases.reply: Hi Wes, the kitchen was due to be finished on Friday 18 September, and the worktops and sink still aren't in, so we're washing up in the bathroom. Could you give me a completion date by Thursday 1 October? I'll pay the final £3,200 as soon as the job's done, as agreed.
cases.note: Facts, the agreed payment as the lever, one dated ask. If Thursday passes, move one step up to a formal written deadline, not a threat.
